OSC32KCTRL.STATUS.XOSC32KRDY -- real hardware self-sets after its own preceding configuration write.
OSCCTRL.STATUS.DFLLRDY -- same category.
OSCCTRL.DPLL0.DPLLSTATUS.{LOCK,CLKRDY} -- same category.
OSCCTRL.DPLL1.DPLLSTATUS.{LOCK,CLKRDY} -- same category.
SERCOM5.CTRLA/SYNCBUSY bit0 (SWRST) -- real hardware self-clears.
SERCOM2.CTRLA/SYNCBUSY bit0 (SWRST) -- same.
SERCOM5.INTFLAG.DRE -- set the moment the peripheral is enabled with nothing queued.
SERCOM2.INTFLAG.DRE -- same.
NVMCTRL.INTFLAG.DONE -- same completion-bit category.

Radio chip-ID probe stand-in: r0=0x12 at the post-SPI-read comparison, standing in for 'a radio module is present and answers with the value real firmware requires' -- a real external-device dependency, not internal chip state; scoped to exactly this one instruction.
PORT.GROUP0.IN bit22 (PA22) held high -- disclosed GPIO-input boundary assumption for the startup reference/input routine's wait loop; no physical function claimed.

DWT->CYCCNT-based microsecond busy-wait helper -- Unicorn's zero-behavior MMIO model never advances DWT->CYCCNT, so this call would spin forever; stubbed to return immediately (structurally unrelated to the fake-tick mechanism).
NVM Software Calibration Row -- a real, factory-programmed per-die area; mapped as a disclosed zero-filled placeholder, not a claim about true calibration values.
